comment: Closure-loop host table, in preference order (OWNER 2026-10-06: EPYC3 > EPYC1 > EPYC2 > PVE1 > AGIdock). cap = 1.2 x cores (OWNER_RULE_LOAD_CAP_20261006.txt): launch only if load1 + pending + job threads <= cap and MemAvailable >= peak + 32 GB. base = run root (NVMe on the EPYCs; EPYC2 /srv/opentallas-scratch is the root disk, so scratch2). max_job_threads / max_job_ram_gb restrict what a single job may take on a host (EPYC3 is the die-top host: 64 thr / 400 GB while no die-top runs; AGIdock has little RAM: jobs <= 20 GB). caps = tools a stage may need on that host (coordinator 2026-10-06: PVE1 is ORFS/docker only; AGIdock has Verilator 5.032 like the EPYCs). A stage's needs (default bench: verilator+iverilog+yosys; calibrate/route/signoff/summary: orfs) must be a subset of its host's caps. LOAD REBALANCE 2 (2026-10-06 21:15): EPYC3 is the die-top host -- spillover_only (chosen only when no other host fits) and reserve_ram_gb 500 kept free for the Qwen die-top run; the loop migrates its pre-CTS (bench/calibrate) jobs off any host above cap. Host choice scores free cores AND free RAM; a job's hosts list is a preference. OWNER 2026-10-06 21:35 (supersedes the 1.2x cap and LOAD REBALANCE 2): MEMORY is the limit -- admit while measured load1 + own launches of the last 10 min (declared threads) <= cap = 3 x cores, AND MemAvailable - own launches' peaks of the last 10 min >= job peak + max(10% host RAM, 32 GB). EPYC3 reserve lifted. LOCALHOST (OWNER 2026-10-07 05:00): added with max_loop_threads 24 and min_free_ram_gb 40. FILL THE FLEET (OWNER 2026-10-07 19:00, integrate agent): per-job max_job_threads / max_job_ram_gb raised to the host (cores; 0.95 x ram_gb) so admission is bound only by measured MemAvailable minus own pending peaks >= job peak + max(5% ram, 32 GB, min_free_ram_gb), the 3 x cores load cap and the disk floor. localhost unchanged (owner cap: 24 loop threads, 60 GB/job). DISK GUARD (2026-10-07 integrate): disk_roots = {path: min free GB} for every other filesystem a host's jobs write (docker /, second scratch); admission refuses while any is below its floor, as for the run root. NO OVERSUBSCRIPTION (OWNER 2026-10-07 19:31): cap = round(1.1 x cores); admit while max(load1, own running declared threads) + own launches of the last 10 min + job threads <= cap (was 3 x cores). RAM headroom = max(5% ram_gb, min_free_ram_gb, default 32 GB): AGIdock 8 GB / PVE1 16 GB so the small hosts take 40 GB jobs. LOCALHOST ROUTES (OWNER 2026-10-07 19:40): localhost bench_offload=true -- a job whose route/calibrate stages need only ORFS may be placed on localhost although its spec hosts list omits it (that list is a preference); its benches run on a fleet host with the bench tools (source synced to <base>/<name>-bench). Guard unchanged: <= 24 loop threads, MemAvailable >= peak + 40 GB. ADMISSION FIX (coordinator 20:05): load term = measured load1 + declared threads of own launches of the last 10 min only; declared threads of long-running stages are no longer counted (they starved the fleet at 38-58 % idle). MEMORY ONLY (OWNER 2026-10-07 20:10, supersedes the 19:31 cap and the 20:05 eff fix): no CPU/load admission check on remote hosts; 'cap' is informational. localhost keeps max_loop_threads 24 / min_free_ram_gb 40. GIT MIRROR (GITMIRROR sub-agent, drive-1010 2026-10-10): git_mirror = a seeded bare repo on the host (marker CL_READY); sync_source fetches the job branch from git_mirror_upstream (public, host -> GitHub), pushes the pinned commit to refs/cl/<sha> only when still missing (bulk direct ssh, delta only), archives on the host and falls back to the tar stream on any failure (tools/closure_loop/git_mirror.py). PVE1 BENCH OFFLOAD (OWNER 2026-10-13 fleet sizing: every machine fully available): ot-pve1 bench_offload=true, as localhost -- it has caps [orfs] only, so every job with a bench stage failed its caps check and PVE1 got 0 of 121 launches in 2 h; routes/calibrates now land there and the benches run on a fleet host with the bench tools. HOST ROLE (FLEET-NEW 2026-10-19): role 'throughput' (ot-epyc7, Zen 3) = tile gates/routes/benches rank it first while its projected load <= 1.0 x cores; die-level jobs (DIE_SPEC_RE name or priority die) rank it after every other host. ALT BASES (FLEET-NEW2 2026-10-19, coordinator): alt_bases = further run roots on other volumes; a job's NEW run dir goes to the base/alt base with the most free disk in the latest probe, and the run-root disk admission uses that best root. A job keeps the dir it was given (live dirs never move). | EPYC4-RETIRE 2026-10-19 (OWNER ~18:45): ot-epyc4 (Cherry 1025189 'regular-crane', Tokyo) terminated once its running jobs finished and its CLOSED results were verified on the AGIdock archive; listed under retired_hosts so old specs pinning it fall back to admission. | FLEET-NEW3 2026-10-24: the old fleet (ot-epyc8, ot-epyc9, ot-gold2, ot-gold1, ot-epyc7, ot-pve1, ot-agidock128, localhost, ot-epyc1..9, rtx-pro localhost) is gone (coordinator rtx-pro died 2026-10-23 23:45 PDT); its entries moved to retired_hosts. New fleet measured 2026-10-24 (docs/FLEET.md): localhost = tender-ray EPYC 9754 (coordinator, shared with ~10 agent sessions: caps orfs+bench tools but max_loop_threads 0 until the owner opens it), epyc2 2x EPYC 7543, epyc3 2x EPYC 7443 (6.9 TB root), intel1/intel2 2x Xeon Gold 6330 (~400 GB root disk: role smalldisk). Run root on every host: /srv/opentallas-scratch (a directory on the root filesystem; ~/ot-scratch links to it). No git_mirror: only localhost reaches GitHub, so sync_source uses the tar stream.
